rows.summary: **Now:** B2 is built — ten designed layouts are engines of their own: Gridline, Registry, Bookend, Lectern, Chronicle, Keystone, Banded, Keel, Linen and Broadsheet, each with its own marks (hairlines, ledger rules, bookend rules, centred titles, mastheads, wedge and edged boxes, bands to the paper's edge, a bar, stitched and short underlines, a headline rule), on one shared header and single column (PdfDesigned) that takes every Header Customization, Name Font, Photo Position, Section Headings → Icons, Links, and Page numbers; their letters, dashboard cards and Word files follow. With B1 (8 designs) and B4 (Save my design) live, the app has 19 templates.
rows.remaining: Owner's calls, not defects: the ten sit in the picker's Simple category (no category of their own), and Banded is not flagged colourHeader; Keel's letterhead draws a horizontal accent rule where its résumé draws a vertical bar (pinned by its test).
